column1: IFRS 15 states that an entity that grants the right to return the product should recognise the revenue for the
transferred products at the amount of consideration to which the entity expects to be entitled, a refund liability,
and an asset for its right to recover products. ROVI recognises its revenues net of estimated returns at the date
of sale, together with the refund liability. The Group does not recognise an asset for its right to recover products
because, based on experience and the type of product sold, the goods returned can no longer be sold or form
The amount of revenue recognised is adjusted for expected returns, which are estimated considering the
average returns rates of recent years.
